scientific_question.branch_question: Which external kinematic dataset is technically qualified to become the first serious source dataset for the Common Pose API?
scientific_question.context: Long-term architecture: wearable EMG -> frozen EMG->continuous hand state -> Common Physical Pose API -> a downstream task model learned from an INDEPENDENT kinematic dataset, so that a task can be defined from pose/kinematics + labels without task-specific EMG.  That architecture has NOT yet been demonstrated and this session does not attempt it.
explicitly_not: not a Common Pose API redesign
scientific_question.prior_branch_context_only: DB9 reached a frozen decision DB9-DROP: not sufficiently reliable as a physical task-source dataset; source-only channel QC left too few trustworthy channels (5 of 16) and did not selectively rescue external human targets.  DB9 may appear here only as historical context and as a LESSON (semantic names do not guarantee a trustworthy physical interface).

KINE_ADL.label: B
KINE_ADL.name: KINE-ADL BE-UJI
KINE_ADL.naming_note: the audited public artifacts for this slot are (i) the BE-UJI hand joint angle calculation code, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8418096 / 3357966, and (ii) the JBU/UJI ADL kinematic family that shares that calibration pipeline.  The audit reports exactly which public artifact each claim comes from and does not invent a separate 'KINE-ADL' release if none is found.

backup_rule: backup candidates are audited ONLY if all three primary candidates are REJECT; the candidate list is not expanded otherwise

order: 4. dataset README / metadata distributed with the files

tag_rules.OFFICIAL-DOCUMENTED: a primary source states it; the URL is recorded
tag_rules.OFFICIAL-CODE-INFERRED: read out of the authors' own released code; the file and line are recorded
tag_rules.DATA-INFERRED: measured by this audit from the released data; the measurement is recorded
tag_rules.PROJECT-FROZEN: recovered from this project's own frozen artifacts
tag_rules.UNKNOWN: not established.  UNKNOWN is a permitted and expected value for units, signs, zero, handedness, calibration and licensing; it is never silently filled in

source_of_truth.unknown_policy: a field that cannot be sourced is recorded as UNKNOWN.  An UNKNOWN in a mandatory admission field blocks ADMIT for that dataset; it does not block CONDITIONAL if the audit names the exact evidence needed.
source_of_truth.url_recording: OFFICIAL_SOURCE_REFERENCES.md must record, for every source: title, URL, publisher/host, access date, what it establishes, and its evidence tag

api_requirement.basis: the project's CURRENT frozen cross-dataset representation, recovered from the frozen adapter and schema - never reconstructed from memory
api_requirement.drop_decision_rule: this audit must decide whether the future API is API-16 or a SMALLER rigorously-shared anatomical subset.  PRINCIPAL RULE: physical semantic equivalence > dimensional count.  A 12-D clean physical mapping beats a 16-D uncertain one.  Dimensional count is never itself a reason to prefer a representation
forbidden: declaring that future datasets must have exactly these 16 dimensions
treating a dataset's angle COUNT as compatibility
accepting 'index flexion' as a match for MCP or PIP or DIP when the dataset does not distinguish them

mapping_rules.unit_of_mapping: API DOF x dataset column, decided independently

confidence.HIGH: the dataset's own documentation or code names the SAME anatomical joint and the SAME anatomical DOF, and the reference posture is documented
confidence.MEDIUM: the anatomical joint matches but one of {DOF axis, reference posture, handedness} needs a documented adapter, or the dataset's name is anatomical but the value is a sensor-derived approximation of it
confidence.LOW: only a coarse or ambiguous correspondence exists - e.g. a relative inter-finger spread standing in for a per-finger AA, or a name that does not distinguish which joint

hard_rules: a coarse name such as 'index flexion' that does not distinguish MCP/PIP/DIP is NONE for each of them - never a one-to-one match
a derived channel (an angle computed from another channel) is flagged as such and cannot be HIGH confidence for an independent DoF
no match may be created or upgraded because it would raise the shared-DOF count
every mapping row records which evidence tag supports it

forbidden: fitting an offset because it makes emg2pose distributions line up
fitting an affine transform using target outcomes
choosing a sign based on downstream classification
using human labels to choose a coordinate transform

definition.DIRECT: same joint, same DOF, same unit, same documented sign, same documented zero - a pure unit conversion if anything
definition.DOCUMENTED_TRANSFORM: a transform is needed and is documented by the dataset's own material
definition.CALIBRATION_REQUIRED: conversion needs a calibration or adapter that the dataset does not itself supply
definition.UNKNOWN: not determinable from the available evidence

ADMIT_requires_all: 1. accessible raw or sufficiently processed data (actually downloadable today, or verifiably delivered)
5. clear sign conventions, or a documented transform
8. sufficient number of common physical DOFs (see MIN_COMMON_DOFS)
10. labels suitable for a pose-observable downstream task
11. no necessary mapping fitted against emg2pose outcomes
admission.CONDITIONAL: promising but one or more SOLVABLE issues require explicit work; the audit must name the issue and the exact evidence or action that would promote it to ADMIT
REJECT_any_of: labels fundamentally not inferable from hand state

MIN_COMMON_DOFS.meaning: at least 8 API DOFs at HIGH or MEDIUM confidence, of which at least 6 must be HIGH
MIN_COMMON_DOFS.why_8: the DB9 branch showed a 5-channel surviving set destroys the internal task (closed-set balanced accuracy 0.978 -> 0.769, correct singleton 0.593 -> 0.330, ambiguity 0.324 -> 0.594). 8 is the smallest count this audit will accept as a task-defining representation and is an a-priori round number, not a fitted one
MIN_COMMON_DOFS.counts_for_admit: HIGH and MEDIUM both count; LOW does not
MIN_COMMON_DOFS.sensitivity: the shared-DOF count is reported at every confidence cut (HIGH only, HIGH+MEDIUM, HIGH+MEDIUM+LOW) so a reader can re-judge, but the DECISION uses HIGH+MEDIUM

MIN_SUBJECTS.why: emg2pose's own cross-subject structure requires a held-out-user axis; below 15 subjects a subject-level split is not credible
MIN_SUBJECTS.counts_for_admit: usable subjects with pose data, not merely enrolled

QUALITY_GATES.widespread_channel_failure: the DB9 failure mode is defined operationally here as: a channel whose documented direction of flexion is violated in the majority of subjects, or a channel that is constant/saturated/aliased.  ANY such channel in a mapped DOF blocks ADMIT for that DOF
QUALITY_GATES.saturation_rule: a mapped channel with more than 1 % of frames pinned at a plausibility bound is reported; if the pinning is an artefact of the released data (not of a genuine end-range posture) it blocks ADMIT

anchor_checks.principle: where raw data and labels permit, test simple anatomical consistency.  This exists specifically to prevent another DB9-type failure, where the channel names were right and the numbers were not

tiers.STRONG: the dataset's own documentation names the joint action for the compared conditions and the comparison isolates it
tiers.WEAK: the conditions imply the action but are multi-joint, or the condition boundary is operator-labelled
tiers.NON-INTERPRETABLE: no defensible comparison exists in this dataset

required_tests: extended -> flexed moves flexion DOFs in the documented direction
open hand occupies the expected side of the flexion range
fist-like or grasp-like postures increase the relevant flexion DOFs
reference/neutral trials satisfy the documented zero semantics
anchor_checks.per_subject: every anchor statistic is computed per subject where the structure allows; frames are never pseudo-replicated as independent subjects
anchor_checks.not_required: not every task is expected to give clean isolated anatomy
anchor_checks.failure_meaning: a mapped DOF whose anchor test fails in the majority of subjects is a quality failure for that DOF and blocks ADMIT for it

where_repeats_exist: agreement of repeated trials of the same labelled condition
quality_checks.pseudo_replication_guard: frames are NEVER treated as independent subjects; the unit of any repeatability statement is subject x condition x trial
quality_checks.cross_dataset_comparison: quality statistics are reported per dataset and NOT ranked against each other into a single score.  What matters is whether a mapped DOF is trustworthy, not which dataset's spread is smaller

questions_per_label_family: A. are the labels primarily determined by hand kinematics?
B. can the task reasonably be inferred from pose alone?
C. does the label require force / object identity / contact / intention / arm pose / temporal context / environment context?
label_suitability.ontology_separation_rule: grasp type, object identity, activity label and action primitive are NOT collapsed into the generic word 'gesture'.  Any label ontology is described in its own terms and classified with its own name
label_suitability.hard_rule: do not choose a dataset whose headline task cannot in principle be decoded from hand pose alone

static_vs_temporal.policy: requiring temporal information is NOT automatically a fail; it is recorded, and a future API of HandState_t = pose + optional short temporal context is a legitimate outcome.  For the FIRST proof-of-concept the audit PREFERS a task evaluable with single-frame or short local kinematics

independence.rule: a second dataset built by the same group with the same glove and the same calibration is USEFUL but is a WEAKER independent replication.  It must not be counted as fully independent physical-source evidence
independence.output: a pairwise overlap report per dimension plus an independence verdict

selection.not_a_criterion: which dataset sounds coolest, or contains EMG, or has more subjects, or has more DOFs
selection.procedure: apply the ADMISSION statuses first; among ADMIT candidates rank by the priority order; if two candidates are close, state the tradeoff explicitly instead of hiding it.  If no candidate is ADMIT, select the highest-priority CONDITIONAL and name the minimum evidence needed to promote it.  If none is even CONDITIONAL, audit DLR then UNIPI.
selection.anti_bias_rule: HUST gets NO priority because earlier discussion liked it; KINE-ADL gets NO priority because its labels sound more interesting; KIN-MUS gets NO priority because it includes EMG.  All three are evaluated under exactly the same criteria, in the same table, with the same evidence tags
selection.tie_rule: if two candidates are within one priority level of each other, the physical-coordinate trustworthiness dimension decides; if THAT ties, the one whose mapped DOFs are fewer but HIGH-confidence wins over the one with more but MEDIUM-confidence DOFs

must_establish: whether an academic account is required
whether raw files are actually downloadable TODAY
access_criteria.evidence_rule: a dataset is NOT reported as available merely because a paper says it exists.  Availability requires an actual HTTP response or a documented delivery mechanism - the audit attempts the download and records the status code and byte count
access_criteria.bounded_download: do not download hundreds of GB; a representative subset or the metadata is enough where the full corpus is large

prohibitions: train any model (classifier, Gate, AutoML, Gaussian/SIMCA/GMM/OCSVM)
optimise any mapping based on external performance
compare Mahalanobis / SIMCA / kNN gate / conformal / selective nets / OpenMax / PROSER / energy methods / prototype OSR
rescue, retune, repair or rerun DB9
modify any frozen artifact of the project
invent a mapping to raise the shared-DOF count
report a dataset as available without an access attempt

interpretation_boundary.may_claim: which dataset is the best current candidate to be the first serious task-source for the Common Pose API, and on what evidence
may_not_claim: that a documentation audit substitutes for an empirical one
interpretation_boundary.documentation_vs_empirical: for every dataset the audit must clearly separate DOCUMENTATION AUDIT COMPLETE from EMPIRICAL DATA QC POSSIBLE / NOT POSSIBLE

runtime.local_training_prohibition: no deep-learning training is run on this machine; nothing in this branch trains anything at all
runtime.network_note: the host resolver blackholes zenodo.org (0.0.0.0); the audit resolves it via an explicit public resolver and passes --resolve to curl.  This is recorded because a reader reproducing the fetch must know it

pre_registration_statement: This plan was written and hashed BEFORE any candidate dataset was compared, before any shared-DOF count was computed, and before any admission status was assigned.  The criteria - evidence tags, confidence categories, the MIN_COMMON_DOFS and MIN_SUBJECTS gates, the quality gates, the anchor tiers, the label-suitability classes and the selection priority order - are frozen as a unit by the SHA-256 of the raw bytes of this document.  No criterion may be changed after seeing which dataset looks favourable.  The sidecar .sha256 file is a convenience copy; the raw-byte hash is the authority.
